issues.detail: The Greek 'διαστασης ωρας μιας' (at the distance of one hour) refers to a spatial/temporal distance, but the Vietnamese 'Cách đó chừng một giờ' (About an hour from there/then) is acceptable. However, the Greek 'αλλος τις διισχυριζετο λεγων επ αληθειας' translates to 'another claimed, saying in truth', whereas the Vietnamese 'có một người khác quả quyết rằng: 'Thật vậy...'

The Greek text says 'αλλος τις διισχυριζετο' (another claimed/asserted), but the Vietnamese adds 'Thật vậy' (Indeed/Truly) as a direct quote, which is an addition of a transitionary phrase not explicitly in the Greek 'επ αληθειας' (in truth).
